verdict.rationale: SAM.gov's Entity Management API supports bulk retrieval. A single request can take up to 100 UEI values, extracts return JSON or CSV up to 1,000,000 records, and a documented API Extract handles bulk pulls, with the download URL optionally delivered by email. Boolean filters let one query select many records at once. These are all read/export operations, though; nothing shows bulk actions that change many items at once. Missing for 10: bulk write/update/mutation operations, batch job status or management, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk extract behavior.
